book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Enyaarubha ya kabhiri ya Pauro ku Timoteo

content: Nirakuswaagya gano embere wa Taatabhugya ne embere wa Krisito Yeesu, wuno akubhatinira ekiina abhahoru na abhaku, na wuno araaze okukaangata kyo omutemi.

Bhoono, obhe orarwaaza eriingʼana rya Taatabhugya. Obhe obhanwiiri okukora ego eriibhaga ryoryoosi, kwiibhaga izomu ne eriibhi. Obhe orarekya, orabhahiinya, orabhatoongera abhaatu. Okore ego, eno oreegya kwo obhugumiru bhwoosi.

Nirakubhuurira ego kwo okubha eriibhaga riraaza, rino abhaatu bharabha bhatakwiigwa ameegyo go obhuheene. Bharabha bhareenda kwiitegeerera gano gakubhazomera, no okusora abheegya bhaaru bho okubheegya gano bhaseegiri okwiigwa.
Bharatiga okwiitegeerera obhuheene, na bharatuniirira amagano ge ekare gano gatana bhweera bhwobhwoosi.
Nawe awe, obhe na kusuuhu mumangʼana goosi, ogumire enyaako, okore emirimo gyo okurwaaza Amangʼana Amazomu, okore bhuzomu mubhubhagati bhwaazo bhwoosi.
Nirakubhuurira gayo, kwo okubha amanyiinga gaane gari haguhi okuruusibhwa kye ekimweeso kya amaanzi go omuzabibu.
Eriibhaga ryaane ryo okukwa rihikiri haguhi.
Niteeni eriihi izomu ryo obhwiikirirya, orugeendo nirumariri, kweeki nigwaatiriri obhwiikirirya.

Bhoono esaagiri kuhaabhwa orusuurya rwe eheene. Omukuru Yeesu, omutini we ekiina we eheene, aranihaana orusiku rurya rwo okuuza kwaaye. Nitari enye omweene ego, nawe na abhaandi bhoosi bhano bhakwiigoomba okukyoora kwaaye.
Amasabhi ga Pauro ku Timoteo
Timoteo, okore omukya bhwaangu okuuza owaane,
kwo okubha Dema anitigiri. Ewe akaseega amangʼana ga mukyaaro, akaamura kugya mumugye gwa Tesaronike. Kiresike agiiri mumugye gwa Garatia, na Tito agiiri mumugye gwa Darimatia.
Ruuka omweene niwe asaagiri hano hamwe neenye. Bhoono, oraaze eno, wuuze na Mariko kwo okubha aranagya kunisakirya emirimo gya Taatabhugya.
Nikamutuma Tikiko mumugye gwa Efeso.
Hano oraaze, wuuze ne ekabhuuti yaane yino nikatiga wa Karipo, mumugye gwa Turoa, hamwe ne ebhitabhu bhyaane kiindi bhirya bhya amasaakwa.
Arekizanda, wurya omuturi we ebhyooma, anikoreeri obhubhi bhukongʼu. Omukuru aramutinira ekiina kuriingʼaana na amahokya gaaye.
Naawe, wiiriibhe neewe, kwo okubha yaari araanga ameegyo geetu bhukongʼu.

Hano nikiisasaama mwiibaraza orugeendo rwaane rwo okutaanga, ataari ariho naabhe muutu wumwe wuno yiimeereeri orubhaara rwaane, bhoosi bhakaanitiga. Nirasabha Taatabhugya atige kubhabharira ebhibhi bhiyo.
Nawe, Omukuru yaari hamwe neenye, akaaniha amanaga okurwaaza Amangʼana Amazomu goosi, okubha abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhatari Abhayahudi bhiigwe. Akaanituurya muruku, kwo okubha niari mumunwa gwe endwi.
Nimenyiri kubha aranituurya mumabhiihu goosi, no okuniriibha tee mubhutemi bhwaaye bhwa mwiisaaro. Omukuru aguungibhwe kirakeego na kirakeego. Gabhe ego.
Amangʼana go okuraga
Okeerye Akiira na mukaaye Prisika, na bhano bhari munyuumba ya Onesiforo.
Erasito akasaaga mumugye gwa Koriinto. Torofimo nikamutiga mumugye gwa Mireto, yaari murweeri.
Bhoono, okore bhwaangu kuuza rikyaari eriibhaga rya nyamabheho. Euburo, Pude, Rino na Kiraudia, hamwe na abhiikirirya bhoosi, bharakukeerya.
Omukuru abhe hamwe naawe. Orubhaango rubhe hamwe neemwe.
